audit_metadata.description: Root cleanup audit — Phase 4 relocation proposals. Proposes MOVE for 83 backup files, DELETE for 7 garbage files, and flags 2 files for HUMAN REVIEW. CRITICAL and HIGH_RISK files annotated as MUST REMAIN. STAGING_DIR directory proposed for archive relocation.

proposals.rationale: Constitution §11.4 explicitly prohibits backup files (.bak) in the repository root. The backups/ directory already exists with 436 files. Moving these 83 .bak files to backups/ requires zero path rewrites — no application code, no configuration, and no tooling references any of these files by root path. All are timestamped backup artifacts from prior sessions (S718, S719, S364, S357, S829, S853, etc.).
proposals.expected_benefit: Removes 107.15 MB of clutter from root directory. Reduces root file count from 111 to 28. Brings repository into compliance with Constitution §11.4. Zero risk to application or tooling.

proposals.authorization_required_per: AGENTS.md §3.1 — Destructive Script Execution Staged Authorization
proposals.rationale: These 7 files are zero-content artifacts (zero-byte files and PowerShell command fragments), exact Windows copy-duplicates of active root files, or empty temporary files. None are referenced by any application code, configuration, or tooling. Deleting them eliminates clutter with zero risk to repository function.
proposals.expected_benefit: Removes 7 garbage artifacts from root. Eliminates confusion risk from Windows duplicate copies masquerading as source files.

files.notes: Command output artifact — variable name from PowerShell session, zero application value
Zero-byte file — fragment of a PowerShell or shell command, zero application value
Zero-byte file — fragment of a command expression, zero application value
PowerShell redirection artifact (1.7 KB), zero application value
2-byte file (likely just '{}' or whitespace), temporary extraction artifact
Exact duplicate of may-core.js (339,453 bytes). Windows '(1)' suffix indicates browser re-download or copy-paste artifact. Active file is may-core.js.
Duplicate of may-learner-state.js (117,009 bytes). Windows '(1)' suffix indicates browser re-download or copy-paste artifact. Active file is may-learner-state.js.

prerequisite.backup_note: Per AGENTS.md §3.1: every file in the deletion list must be backed up to a timestamped path before deletion, even files classified as garbage.
prerequisite.authorization_phrase_required: User must use: 'delete the files' or 'execute the cleanup' or equivalent explicit authorization

proposals.rationale: Both files have legitimate root presence but may benefit from organized relocation. Human review required because path references must be verified and updated.
proposals.expected_benefit: If moved: further root decluttering. If retained: documented exception to §11.4 for files that are root-required by tooling or architecture.

files.rationale: User confirmed this is a legitimate admin console, not garbage. The <script src="scripts/output/admin_dashboard_data.js"> reference is already relative and would work from a subfolder, but styles.css references may need path updates. Requires human decision: keep in root (administrative UI) or relocate to a subfolder with path rewrites.
files.risk_if_moved: Broken CSS/JS references if paths not rewritten
files.risk_if_kept_in_root: Minor — Constitution §11.4 prohibits non-application root files, but admin.html is an application file. Needs explicit exemption or relocation.

files.rationale: Referenced by opencode.json as an instructions file. The opencode tooling reads this file at session start. Moving it would require updating the opencode.json path reference. Also referenced by .opencode/plugins/governance-guard.js FileContext resolution. The Constitution §11.4 permits root-level files 'required to run the application' — AGENTS.md is tooling-required, not application-required. Requires human decision on whether to keep in root (tools path convention) or relocate to knowledge/ (organized structure) with opencode.json update.
files.risk_if_moved: Broken AI tooling session startup if opencode.json not updated simultaneously
files.risk_if_kept_in_root: Minor — AGENTS.md is small (0.02 MB) and legitimately consumed by tooling. Acceptable root resident.

must_remain.description: These 19 files must NOT be moved or deleted. They are the active application and configuration files that define the running simulator.

critical_files.classification: Application source — moving any of these breaks the simulator

high_risk_files.classification: Configuration and metadata — moving any of these breaks tooling or dependency resolution

staging_dir.rationale: STAGING_DIR contains S853 and S867 session artifacts (certification candidate analysis, staging payloads, guard pass logs). These are session-level operational files, not application files. They should live in archive/ or scripts/output/ rather than in root. Zero application code references this directory. The 95% confidence reflects the need to verify no pipeline script references STAGING_DIR by root-relative path.
affected_systems: Any pipeline script hardcoding root\STAGING_DIR as path — needs verification before move

summary.constitution_compliance: After MOVE + DELETE: root contains only active application files (15), config files (4), and 2 human-review files (admin.html, AGENTS.md). Constitution §11.4 satisfied — zero .bak files, zero garbage, zero temp files in root.
